posts.title: Adventures in Boat Tracking
posts.description: I’d always wanted to visit the Galapagos islands. I’m not sure why, I think the idea of it being one of the few places left on earth unspoiled by humans, combined with it being the place that inspired Darwin to discover evolution by natural selection… I think the islands are a very important place in the world, and I wanted to see them myself.

posts.title: Open Data Anti-Hero - drashsmith.com
posts.description: Learning to use technology and preventing it from using me. Hello, I’m Ash. I like data. I used to be an Open Data Specialist for a university IT department and, before that, a Computer Science researcher.
